- Entity B: Acme Solutions UK Ltd | VAT ID GB987654321 | remit: UK (separate invoice numbering)

2) Preferred delivery: our AP system can ingest via SFTP into the portal (preferred), but we still need an email copy routed to ap@acmemed.com and accounting_eu@acmed.com for reconciliation.

Hi Sophie — great to hear from you and thanks for the clear list. High-level options below; I also attached a small sample XML we can generate if your AP system prefers machine-readable files.

Quick answers:
- Yes — we can create separate billing profiles per legal entity so each profile issues its own invoice numbers and remit fields. That is the cleanest approach for audit and VAT compliance.
- Delivery: we support SFTP drops to a secure ingestion point (portal) and can optionally send mirror copies to one or more email addresses per profile. So SFTP primary + email copies to ap@acmed.com + accounting_eu@acmed.com is feasible.
- VAT evidence: for the German entity we can attach the VAT certificate (PDF) automatically to each invoice if you provide the cert and confirm the filename/metadata convention.
- PO matching & aggregation: PO numbers can be included on line-items. We can enable an optional monthly consolidated invoice that aggregates low-value charges but still includes entity-level line breakdowns.

Tradeoffs & setup notes:
- SFTP ingestion: requires a technical handshake (public key + path mapping) and a one-time provisioning window (we usually do this in the onboarding call, ~30-45 minutes).
- XML vs PDF: we produce PDF by default; XML/UBL or a simple custom XML payload is available (see attached sample). If you want PEPPOL, that is an add-on and requires additional identity steps from your AP team.
- Cost/contract: SFTP + VAT-attachment automation is standard for enterprise customers; PEPPOL e-invoicing or custom connectors may incur a small setup fee — I will confirm with Ben.

Next actions I suggest:
1) Confirm you want separate billing profiles for the two entities.
2) Confirm email copy recipients and whether you want consolidated monthly sweeping enabled.
3) If yes, please upload the VAT certificate (Germany) and confirm desired filename convention (we recommend: acme_gmbh_vat_cert.pdf).

If you want, we can run a short onboarding call Wednesday 18th at 10:00 CET to provision SFTP keys and test an invoice drop.

Thanks,

Thanks for the ping, Marissa. Quick notes from billing/finance side: 

- Separate billing profiles: fully supported. Each profile gets its own invoice sequence and remit block. No backend limit. We'll need the legal name, VAT/Tax ID, billing address and preferred currency for each profile to complete configuration.
- VAT attachment: our invoice renderer can include an attachment per invoice (we store the filename reference in metadata). Laura will help with the ingestion mapping. We recommend the uploaded cert be canonicalized (lowercase, no spaces) for automation: acme_gmbh_vat_cert.pdf.
- SFTP + email mirror: standard. For SFTP we provision a unique path per-profile. Email mirrors can be 1-3 addresses; we will add a flag to suppress personally identifiable data in the email subject/body if needed.
- Monthly consolidated sweep: we can produce a single consolidated PDF with entity-level sections. However, for legal compliance invoices must still exist per-entity. Our invoice-packager will bundle them into a single PDF without altering per-entity invoice numbers. There is no additional recurring charge for bundling; one-time config only.

Action items & owners:
- Laura: provision SFTP paths and shared test credentials for both profiles. (Laura to schedule provisioning call with Acme.)
- Marissa: confirm the exact recipient emails and whether they want the consolidated bundle enabled.
- Ben (me): confirm any contract language needed for PEPPOL/PEF if they request on later date.

I can also approve a one-time implementation slot this week for provisioning.

—Ben
